title: 第22章 贩卖第23章 屠龙者
slug: 异界冒险从组建冒险团开始
content_zh:
沃尔做了一个手势，正好脱去锁子甲换休的阿尔文小跑上前，他张开手臂道：
“请不要害怕，先生们，我们是冒险者，在之前的冒险中获得了一些有价值的战利品，听说这里能以合适的价格收购。”
见来人没有穿甲，两个看守这才松了一口气，听了阿尔文的话，比较机灵的看守立即说道：
“那你们在原地等待一会，我这就去通知管家过来。”
他拍了拍同伴的肩膀：
“你在这里看着他们，不要让这些人乱跑。”
说完，也不管同伴瞪大的眼睛，一溜烟跑进不远处的工坊内部，留下另一个看守和阿尔文尴尬地对视着。
不过没一会，十几个壮年男人便风风火火地跑了过来。
他们衣着各异，不少穿着短衫，似乎是皮革工坊的工人。
见沃尔一群人似乎真没恶意，一个穿着得体，面容有些古板严肃的高瘦中年人来到沃尔面前，轻轻躬身道：
“冒险者阁下，您想要售卖些什么？”
沃尔也没有废话，让士兵将装着哥布林生皮的大麻袋打开，并从中取出一件展示。
中年管家并没有意外，而是上前几步，仔细嗅了嗅，又从衣兜里取出一张帕子捏起皮子一角，将上面的草木灰抹去后仔细查看。
“新鲜的哥布林生皮，剥取时间不到一天。”
中年管家又看了看袋子内，回头对沃尔说道：
“确实是不错的战利品，只是剥取的手法粗糙了一些，价值有所影响。”
沃尔并不在意，直截了当问道：
“贵工坊能出一个什么价格，如果合适，这些皮子都卖给你们，一共18张躯干皮，16张头皮。”
中年管家扫视一番沃尔的部队，突然靠近了一步，小声问道：
“冒险者阁下，您是否有哥布林其他的素材出售？”

说着，这个面容古板的中年管家熟练地比出一个手势。
沃尔有些无语，仔细回想学过的内容，哥布林这种魔物，最受欢迎的素材不应该是皮料吗？
怎么是哥布林器官最受欢迎？
不过都是要卖的，给谁都一样。
沃尔微微侧身偏头，在旁边待命的霍恩立刻转身，将马车上一个木桶打开。
木桶里面装了一半的盐水，里面泡着八条大海参一样的哥布林器官。
中年管家靠近木桶，对着一根哥布林器官仔细观察，终于露出一个满意的笑容。
“很不错，这些我都要了。”
有了哥布林器官作为价码，沃尔立刻开始就价格拉扯起来，磨炼起自己的交易技能。
不过这中年管家似乎经历过这方面的职业训练，沃尔根本不是对手，磨蹭半个小时也没能把价格提上去。
“躯干皮30铜币一张，头皮50铜币一张，哥布林器官40铜币一根，成交！”
期间，中年管家将所有货物一一检查，沃尔松口后便立刻完成了这笔交易。
又有1600枚铜币入账，沃尔哼着小曲穿过城门进入外城，直奔冒险者广场。
进入委托接取楼，沃尔先去墙边看了一下，之前那两个驱逐狼群和猎杀巨棕熊的任务果然已经被接取。
递交任务契约，再缴纳40枚铜币的任务管理费之后，这个任务就算正式完成了。
冒险者工会只抽取十分之一，算是非常公道。
content_en:
Wall made a gesture, and Alvin, who just took off his chainmail to change his clothes, trotted forward. He opened his arms and said:
"Please don't be afraid, gentlemen. We are adventurers. We have obtained some valuable loot in previous adventures. I heard that we can buy it at a suitable price here."
Seeing that the person who came was not wearing armor, the two guards breathed a sigh of relief. After hearing Alvin's words, the smarter guard immediately said:
"Then you just wait where you are for a while, and I'll notify the housekeeper to come over."
He patted his companion on the shoulder:
"You watch them here, don't let these people run around."
After saying that, regardless of the widened eyes of his companion, he quickly ran into the workshop not far away, leaving the other guard and Alvin looking at each other awkwardly.
But after a while, a dozen strong men came running over in a hurry.
They were dressed in different styles, many of them wearing short shirts, and seemed to be workers in leather workshops.
Seeing that Wall's group of people seemed to have no ill intentions, a tall, thin, middle-aged man who was well-dressed and had a somewhat rigid and serious face came to Wall, bowed gently and said:
"Sir Adventurer, what do you want to sell?"
Wall didn't waste any time and asked the soldiers to open the large sack containing the goblin hides and take out one piece for display.
The middle-aged housekeeper was not surprised, but took a few steps forward, sniffed it carefully, took out a handkerchief from his pocket, pinched a corner of the leather, wiped off the plant ash on it, and looked at it carefully.
"Fresh goblin hide, peeled in less than a day."
The middle-aged butler looked inside the bag again, then turned back to Wall and said:
"It is indeed a good trophy, but the method of stripping it is a little rough, which affects the value."
Wall didn't care and asked directly:
"What price can your workshop give? If it's suitable, I'll sell these skins to you. A total of 18 torso skins and 16 scalp skins."
The middle-aged butler glanced at Wall's troops, suddenly took a step closer, and asked in a low voice:
"Sir Adventurer, do you have any other Goblin materials for sale?"
As he spoke, the middle-aged butler with a stern face made a skillful gesture.
Wall was speechless and thought carefully about what he had learned. Shouldn't the most popular material for monsters like Goblins be leather?
Why are goblin organs the most popular?
But they all have to be sold, to everyone.
Wall tilted his head slightly, and Horn, who was standing by, immediately turned around and opened a barrel on the carriage.
The wooden barrel was half filled with salt water, and eight sea cucumber-like goblin organs were soaked in it.
The middle-aged butler approached the barrel, carefully observed a goblin organ, and finally showed a satisfied smile.
"Very good, I want all of these."
With the goblin organ as a price tag, Wall immediately began to negotiate the price and hone his trading skills.
However, this middle-aged butler seemed to have experienced professional training in this area. Wall was no match at all, and he failed to raise the price even after half an hour.
"The torso skin costs 30 copper coins each, the scalp costs 50 copper coins, and the goblin organ costs 40 copper coins. Deal done!"
During this period, the middle-aged butler inspected all the goods one by one, and the transaction was completed immediately after Volson said it.
With another 1,600 copper coins in his account, Wall hummed a tune and walked through the city gate into the outer city, heading straight to the Adventurer's Square.
Entering the commission reception building, Wall first went to the wall to take a look. As expected, the two previous missions of expelling wolves and hunting giant brown bears had been accepted.
After submitting the task contract and paying the task management fee of 40 copper coins, the task will be officially completed.
The Adventurer's Guild only takes one-tenth of the money, which is very fair.
